The so-called '''Turret Room''' was a series of lavish chambers contained within the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Located at the back of the palace, its purpose was to house visiting dignitaries. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the Turret Room briefly hosted the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==History==
[[File:Turret_Room_tower.png|thumb|left|200px|The square tower that hosted the Turret Room]]
The Turret Room was one of the oldest part of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]], the nerve center of all politics on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was built by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Jafan/Legends|Jafan]] around [[832 BBY/Legends|832 BBY]] to entertain the rulers of the formerly independent city-states that had merged to form a united Naboo kingdom under his rule.<ref name="OSVC36">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 36|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 36]]</ref> After Naboo joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="SWCL" /> eight hundred and forty-seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Crisis">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref> the chambers collectively known as the Turret Room were used to house visiting dignitaries from other worlds and their staff. Throughout history, that section of the palace among those that were extended frequently by the succeeding monarchs.<ref name="SWCL" />

It was in the Turret Room that the famous [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was granted the title of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]],<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> At the time, the room barely contained one table, several high back seats and a few low armchairs.<ref name="TPM" /> Around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> the tower that housed the Turret Room was briefly featured in a commercial released by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency to promote trips to Naboo.<ref name="ST:AC">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' {{C|Advertisement only}}</ref>

==Layout==
The Turret Room's suite of chambers was located behind the [[Throne room (Theed Royal Palace)/Legends|throne room]] building, at the top level of a square tower&mdash;one of the many towers that made up the rear side of the palace.<ref name="SWCL" /> Like the throne room itself, those many-[[Window/Legends|windowed]]<ref name="TPMJN">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' junior novelization]]</ref> chambers were walled with [[Color/Legends|red]], grey and brownish [[Marble/Legends|marble]] slabs, and they contained only a few, simple furnitures,<ref name="TPM" /> in keeping with the austere style featured everywhere in the palace.<ref name="SON">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> Their floor was also made of marble and was ornate with a large motif consisting of concentric squares.<ref name="TPM" /> Attached to the suite was a small chapel where the Naboo sovereign could pay homage to his or her predecessors.<ref name="SWCL" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Three days later, Obi-Wan Kenobi stood in a small room of the Theed temple in which the deaths of heroes were mourned and their lives celebrated.|Extract from ''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' novelization|<ref name="TPMN">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The Turret Room was one of the locations featured in the [[1999]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]]. Although the movie itself<ref name="TPM" /> and its young readers' [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (junior novelization)|adaptation]]<ref name="TPMJN" /> clearly established the Turret Room as a part of the Royal Palace,<ref name="TPM" /><ref name="TPMJN" /> in the adult readers' [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]], the chamber in which Yoda knighted Obi-Wan Kenobi was part of Theed's [[Theed Funeral Temple/Legends|Funeral Temple]].<ref name="TPMN" /> The proper location of the Turret Room was also confirmed in the movie's script as is available in the interactive CD-ROM ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]''.<ref name="TPMIG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>
